lifecycle_shutdown_review_20261103.review: Stopping admission cancels with kShutdown and returns the existing cancellation branch; first terminal reason wins, abort accounting and SSE error terminal share the established path. No wire fields/routes changed.

media_admission_review_20261103.review: User-only closed media shapes and canonical base64; PNG/JPEG metadata before decoding; shared source and geometry plans, aggregate resource and expanded slot budgeting; owned C decoder quota and decoded-size recheck; cooperative cancellation and queried effective attention shared capacity. No route/top-level field addition, numerical kernels or resampler math change. Physical RAM and runtime GPU acceptance remain open.

error_param_review.scope: Tool/output-constraint explicit paths; acceptance, errors, prompt and grammar must remain unchanged

operations_listener_review.review: Explicit loopback listener, independent total and classified ownership, body-before-route refusal, unchanged client authentication, dual setup/shutdown ownership, v5 configuration and metrics. No wire Chat fields or primary routes changed. Development reviewed; CPU and native/model acceptance pending.

startup_listener_review.review: Actual dual listeners before tokenizer/cache/model/CUDA allocation, transactional RAII ownership, unchanged handlers/authentication/route and field allowlists. Warmup TCP queue is not HTTP readiness; no startup response thread or signal-handler change. Single-use Start and partial model destruction contract explicit. CPU inventory failure preserved; native and real startup acceptance pending.

prepare_lock_review.review: Cancellation-aware tokenizer acquisition only in thinking preparation, Chat encode and preflight. Waiter own cancellation before/during/after acquire; owner unaffected, unchanged errors/JSON/SSE/lease owners and tokenizer numerical work. No fields/routes/schema or scheduling change; cooperative 5ms polling, not a realtime guarantee. Validation pending. CMake adds EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL real-handler probe with the same production startup reservation/quota/cleanup linkage; no default runner link behavior changes. Initial probe link failure and inventory CMake-anchor omission retained; targeted fixes do not change runtime code.

prefill_scoring_review.review: CMake only adds an EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL independent GPU contract target, with no default runner linkage or compiler option change. MtpDraftExtend retains argument/slot/position validation and existing cleanup ownership; only host-known uniform T>4 multi-slot prefill passes a compressed-key scoring slice. Pooled KV/index writes, slot offsets, mixed-slot and T<=4 dispatch remain intact. No field, route, whitelist, template, output-parser, scheduling, quota or cancellation implementation changes. Existing min-slot capacity bounds remain in force. BF16 GEMM replaces SIMT scoring arithmetic in this path; numerical/performance acceptance is separately pending, not certified by this inventory. Protocol source hash changes because src/mtp/mtp.cu is included; old packages and durable tasks stay pinned.

client_governance_review.review: Optional strict v2 private client policy, per-client mutex fixed-window RPM/TPM with outstanding reservation and scope/terminal settlement; preflight/control exempt. Slot-only round robin and equal bounded waiting shares, no preparation/GPU-time/latency guarantee. Authenticated fixed identity inventory, text-only policy and limits remain; v1 and no-policy retain FIFO and no minute accounting. Additive config/preflight/capabilities and bounded metric labels, no fields/routes/output/parser/model math change. Actual prompt and logical generated usage charged including cancel. Existing lease/queue lock ownership retained. CPU/HTTP acceptance pending; old packages/tasks remain pinned.

reference_refresh_qsa_review.review: Optional QSA timing remains disabled by default. Layer-type aliases/rejection and ordered large-T softmax passed scoped CPU, complete three-mode five-context HTTP, independent arithmetic/full-layer four-slot state, tool/cache loops and installed health. Model source fingerprint and protocol declarations are renewed; no new wire fields/routes, client WIP, managed/task migration or statistical noninferiority claim. Timing may also cover non-checkpoint mixed batches; T alone does not prove prefill.

vision_v1_review.scope: Official HF CPU independent full tower revealed and fixed shared rotary-reference defect and merger activation. Four CUDA full tower cases pass original bounds. Image/structured/tool business and scoped real TLS media governance verified; four structured temporal-direction quality cases remain failed, ordinary video diagnosis correct. Final default MTP protection passed; scoped release preparation and exact rollback, no long soak or hardware decode acceptance.
